extension.summary: No scrolling. No deciding. Just watching.
extension.description: Tired of scrolling through your library wondering what to watch? EasyTV handles it. It tracks your shows and always knows your next episode. When you're ready for something new, it'll suggest a show you haven't started. Throw in some movies if you want. Just sit down, press play, and enjoy. Built for Kodi 21+.
extension.news:
v1.10.0 (2026-09-04) - Guided questions grew modes: Ask each launch, apply a Pre-set value silently, or Skip a question entirely - Pre-fill answers in settings: genre pickers, episode length, recency in years, rating and how-much-to-watch presets - When a question is still asked, its preset comes pre-selected (your remembered answer wins if you have one) - A clone with everything Pre-set or Skip launches straight into a matching browse or playlist: a one-click saved mood - Note: the six "Ask about..." toggles became mode settings; re-pick Skip if you had turned a question off
v1.9.0 (2026-09-04) - New: Guided questions. Answer a few quick questions (genres, episode length, era, rating, how much to watch) and EasyTV only offers shows that match your mood - Off by default: turn it on under Settings > EasyTV > Guided questions and choose which questions get asked - Answers apply to one launch only and are never saved to settings; optionally remember them as next time's pre-selected defaults - Works on top of your existing filters: smart playlist selections, premieres and watched settings still apply - Clones get their own independent copy, so a clone can be a saved mood
